note: Regenerable from scripts/export_model_artifacts.py given the corpora. Every entry below carries the sha256 of the file it names, so a reader can check what they got against what was produced. One detector per (dataset, seed) serves all three target classes of that cell, so 15 detectors cover the 45 cells of the matrix.

artifacts.note: The surrogate a Slack-style scaffold routes off-manifold probes to, trained with the real model's 12 most important features permuted. Rebuild the wrapper as ScaffoldedDetector(real, surrogate, OODDetector(contamination=0.3, seed=seed)). An exact attributor reads the real model and is NOT fooled -- that is architectural, not an empirical finding.
The component the scaffold routes non-probe inputs to.

The isolation forest that decides which inputs are explainer probes. Needs joblib and the scikit-learn version recorded here; OODDetector(contamination=0.3, seed=seed).fit(X[tr]) rebuilds it from the training rows instead.
